intent_0000380v0879x1qrpeygtbas6g.statement: Codex users can complete traceable, spec-driven coding sprints with evidence-based QA across sessions
intent_0000380v0879x1qrpeygtbas6g.rationale: Prevent intent loss, fragmented implementation, false completion, and secret exposure

intent_0000380v1bjszxx5fvyqj97dbc.statement: Archived sprints retain verifiable reports and QA evidence
intent_0000380v1bjszxx5fvyqj97dbc.rationale: Historical evidence must survive document relocation

intent_0000380v2edshbndyv7s262qx4.statement: Codex can explain implementation structure and verify intent-driven UX and data journeys with capability-aware evidence
intent_0000380v2edshbndyv7s262qx4.rationale: Resolve WP-08 and WP-10 carry items without overclaiming unavailable semantic or runtime observations

intent_0000380v3zvc1mw49fqkmyt0d0.statement: Repository owners can manage bounded exceptions and safely migrate or repair workflow state

intent_0000380v4qr9wrhtaf3y350ydm.statement: QA proves a complete user journey across browser API business rules and persisted data

intent_0000380wh9zhz8jw25h22w5za8.statement: Codex receives bounded and fresh requirement context with explicit graph impact
intent_0000380wh9zhz8jw25h22w5za8.rationale: Prevent stale, unrelated, and untraced context from creating fragmented implementations

intent_0000380wjjwe31ffek75hgbm0r.statement: Workflow profiles, approvals, repair loops, and deferred work are deterministic and auditable
intent_0000380wjjwe31ffek75hgbm0r.rationale: Prevent unlimited agent loops and implicit permission or gap suppression

intent_0000380wmeaq2385aepwf1bsqc.statement: Workflow state is replayable and recoverable from verified journal checkpoints
intent_0000380wmeaq2385aepwf1bsqc.rationale: Prevent corrupted projections and nondeterministic graph churn from losing session context

intent_0000380wp1g79k7a136ay9wx00.statement: Codex users can explicitly or implicitly select the correct tene skill without unsafe workflow mutation.
intent_0000380wp1g79k7a136ay9wx00.rationale: Portable spec-driven workflow requires observable, deterministic routing behavior in addition to model discovery.

intent_0000380wpyxj67yt4xvdz94fcr.statement: Secret-required workflows use tene as a strict value boundary and adversarial QA cannot false-pass leaked or poisoned evidence.
intent_0000380wpyxj67yt4xvdz94fcr.rationale: The plugin must preserve product intent without exposing credentials to Codex, state, documents, logs, or artifacts.

intent_0000380wqhjfnbjh3xxzpkhg1c.statement: The same tene architecture analysis remains useful and uncertainty-honest across greenfield web, mature monolith, and polyglot service repositories.
intent_0000380wqhjfnbjh3xxzpkhg1c.rationale: Portability is a blocking product outcome, not an inferred property of unit tests in this repository.

intent_0000380wr877dd8bq79gacg7kc.statement: Maintainers can build, verify, publish, install, update, and uninstall a trustworthy tene-codex public plugin artifact.
intent_0000380wr877dd8bq79gacg7kc.rationale: Marketplace readiness requires reproducible supply-chain and clean-profile evidence, not only source tests.

intent_0000380wrs7a7t859epzgtpes4.statement: Every required FR, product AC, and work package has a verified implementation and evidence locator, with no hidden open work.
intent_0000380wrs7a7t859epzgtpes4.rationale: Completion must be proved against the authored PRD, plan and design rather than inferred from prior sprint reports.

intent_0000380wvk7q507samchfwpvxw.statement: QA completion must be impossible unless each blocking acceptance criterion is supported by fresh, redaction-safe assertions that cover every required QA layer and observable journey expectation, with deterministic independent evaluation.
intent_0000380wvk7q507samchfwpvxw.rationale: Close the false-pass paths found by the independent semantic audit.
